test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

CREAM : FPJYZ :: CHECK : ?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

CREAM : FPJYZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c46e79da120dc8e6bba9a8d2611b3ba93f32d026d8d944399e3c712b283688b5.png] 

Similarly,

**CHECK : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3ae3d4482db6ca94e0493f4c6462ad9c51c0909efec46210db5a5ef447babc0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc441e7f7ba4ecb7d3c32e6122154c577131f581651ec9b278ba9b8981e087bf.png] 

Hence, **'CHECK'** is coded as "**FFJAV**".
